raw_mirror_dna.master_prompt_en: A young adult woman, 18-24 years old, is seated on the floor, leaning forward, head tilted slightly, making direct eye contact with a gentle closed-mouth smile, soft dimples, and bright, engaged eyes. Her long, layered, wavy dark espresso brown hair with auburn highlights frames her face, with tendrils sweeping across her forehead. She wears a lightweight, cream-white ribbed knit spaghetti strap camisole with a faded greyish-blue floral print and delicate lace trim, paired with casual mid-wash blue denim jeans. Visible are small natural freckles across her nose and cheeks, soft rosy blush, extended eyelashes, glossy pink lips, and a tiny silver nostril piercing. A thin silver hoop earring adorns her left ear, and a delicate silver chain necklace with a small, faceted clear pendant rests on her chest. The candid, vertical portrait is captured with a modern smartphone camera from a slightly elevated angle, creating soft natural contrast and subtle sensor grain in shadows. The background is a cozy, personal bedroom interior featuring a white rumpled bed, a lime-green frog plush toy, a wall collage of small photos, an artificial ivy vine, and a tall dark-framed mirror reflecting a dim corner. Soft, diffuse ambient daylight from an unseen window to the left illuminates the scene evenly, creating a relaxed and intimate atmosphere.
